description: Full validation matrix on Windows hardware: 1080p60, 1440p60, 4K60 across NVIDIA (NVENC), AMD (AMF), and Intel (QSV) GPUs. Measure: capture latency, encode latency, end-to-end frame time, CPU usage, GPU usage, memory footprint, disk I/O. Compare against Linux v2.0.0 baselines — target equal or better on equivalent hardware. Test 30-minute sustained recording for thermal/memory stability. Document results per GPU vendor.
title: Windows performance validation matrix
